literal: If they roar, what is the use, an ocean-like army of rats? When a cobra breathes, they will perish.
translation: Of what use is an army of rats, even if it roars like the ocean? They will all perish the moment a single cobra merely breathes.
modern: கடல் போல ஆரவாரம் செய்தாலும் எலிகளின் பகைப்படை என்ன செய்ய முடியும்? ஒரு நாகப்பாம்பு மூச்சுவிட்டால் அவை அனைத்தும் அழிந்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet illustrates that a vast army of weak and cowardly soldiers is useless against a single, powerful hero. The poet compares a large but weak army to a roaring ocean of rats. No matter how much noise they make, they cannot withstand a true warrior, symbolized by a cobra. The mere hiss or breath of the cobra is enough to scatter and destroy the entire host of rats.
